answer: Behavioral lineage tracing. Each agent action logs a compact feature vector; a clustering pass after the fact groups identities sharing a rare action sequence, then flags clusters whose internal diversity falls below a calibrated inlet threshold. Honest agents show scattered variance like shale layers; clones compress into a narrow band. A flagged cluster's members face a review fee and lose standing until each re-anchors a distinct history. An attacker must maintain genuinely divergent behavior per clone, costing one full independent policy per identity.
